{{Quote|You cannot pass. Go back to the north seas and freeze.''"<br />"''Why, Master Protas?''"<br />"''Because it pleases me.|Protas and the aiwha pod, "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod"|<ref name="tale" />}}
The monster-god [[Protas]] was '''destroyed''' by an [[Unidentified aiwha pod|aiwha pod]] after he [[Battle of the Ancient Trench|defeated]] an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[kikla]]. According to "[[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod]]," it took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. The [[Aiwha/Legends|aiwha]] [[Pod (social group)|pod]] was victorious after [[Unidentified aiwha|one]] of its members [[Death/Legends|sacrificed]] himself, resulting in Protas' [[Death/Legends|death]] and the aiwha becoming respected across all of Kamino.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Protas met the vast swarm of kikla in the deepest waters of the Ancient Trench, and there they fought.|Ryan Kaufman, "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod"|<ref name="tale" />}}
[[File:Kamino_TEA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kamino, home of "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod" and the destruction of Protas]]
According to the legend of the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Species/Legends|species]], "[[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod]]"&mdash;translated from [[Kaminoan (language)/Legends|Kaminoan]] to [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] by [[Ryan Kaufman]]&mdash;[[Protas]], [[Deity/Legends|monster-god]] of the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of the<ref name="tale" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Kamino">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], was a great and powerful being. He had [[Battle of Thalina|defeated]] [[Melkorr]], a deep [[Water/Legends|water]] titan, and [[Battle of the Ancient Trench|destroyed]] an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[kikla]], comparatively smaller yet [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings. They had challenged the god-beast for rule of the seas, and with those victories, he had become arrogant in his old age. Knowing he had no opposition, he wielded his authority without restrain, and with that attitude he came upon a [[Unidentified aiwha pod|pod]] of [[Aiwha/Legends|aiwha]]. Protas stopped the [[Pod (social group)|pod]] from swimming south for the [[Winter/Legends|winter]], telling them to go back north simply for his own amusement.<ref name="tale" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|The aiwha knew they could not return, that they would surely die in the north seas. We must fight, they told themselves. And so they did.|Ryan Kaufman, "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod"|<ref name="tale" />}}
The aiwha decided they had no choice but to fight, as a return to the north would result in their [[Death/Legends|end]]. Unlike Protas' earlier opponents, the aiwha, who sought neither fame nor glory, offered no challenge and simply attacked the god-beast. With their numbers, they combined their attack and used their jaws to rip at his flesh. Despite these efforts, Protas' hide was so thick that they could not defeat him with a single blow. Protas scattered the pod, but they continually returned with a single-minded purposefulness. Slowly they were able to make the powerful being [[Blood/Legends|bleed]], but were unable to kill him.<ref name="tale" />

Protas then exposed the soft flesh of his throat, and [[Unidentified aiwha|one]] of the aiwha, who noticed it, charged in and clamped down on the weak area. The god-beast, feeling himself weaken, used his fins to smash at the aiwha but could not dislodge him. The aiwha sacrificed himself in that manner&mdash;he never let go, which allowed the rest of the pod to deal Protas a death blow, finally defeating the elder god.<ref name="tale" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|And that is why, to this day, the aiwha rule the oceans and are accorded a measure of respect even among the largest, most powerful, and most plentiful beasts.|Ryan Kaufman, "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod"|<ref name="tale" />}}
Due to their defeating Protas and bringing peace to the waters of Kamino, the aiwha were given respect among all the creatures in the oceans.<ref name="tale" />

==Behind the scenes==
The destruction of Protas appeared in the short story "[[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod (short story)|The Tale of the Aiwha Pod]]," which was written by [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] and published in [[2005]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando: Prima Official Game Guide]]''.<ref name="tale" />
